div.div:
However, there is a "default" system at play regarding the internal plugins
(the ones you don't see in your YAML, like LeastAllocated or ImageLocality).

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 558px; height: 1px; padding-top: 317px; margin-left: 2px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
If you write a simple pod with no affinity rules, the scheduler still scores nodes using its built-in plugins and default weights:
NodeResourcesFit (LeastAllocated): 1
BalancedAllocation: 1
ImageLocality: 1
InterPodAffinity / NodeAffinity / TopologySpread: 2
TaintToleration: 3

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 368px; height: 1px; padding-top: 7px; margin-left: 150px;

display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Score grows with the total size of the cached images (scaled by how many nodes have them).
Big image fully cached: near 100.
Nothing cached: Score = 0.
